svg.title: Two enlarged cross-sections of one small lined hole through a flat pale oxide and a thin hatched film down to a thin purple pad. Before the step a thin purple film lines the hole and covers the flat top. After it a cross-hatched grey metal fills the hole and covers the whole top in an even layer, with a shallow dip over the hole.

svg.text: Tungsten is grown by CVD over the whole
wafer until every lined hole is closed.
After: tungsten fills the hole and covers the field
Close-up of the right-hand metal contact, enlarged
about 2.7×; the lower part of the slice is not drawn.
Not to scale. Thin films are drawn thicker than they are.
